title: Sebastian and the Choir Anew
author: Lena Marchetti
blurb: Astrid Iversen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
